description: This file defines a lightweight digital signal processing (DSP) chain for audio processing in Flutter, including filters, noise gate, and equalization presets.

classes.name: DspChain
classes.description: A class that applies a chain of audio DSP effects such as filtering, noise gating, and equalization to PCM float samples.

classes.name: _OnePoleFilter
classes.description: A helper class implementing a one-pole filter (low-pass or high-pass), used within the DSP chain.

methods.name: DspChain.process
methods.description: Processes a list of audio samples in-place applying gain, noise reduction, and equalization based on provided presets.

methods.name: _applyNoiseGate
methods.description: Applies a simple envelope follower-based noise gate to reduce background hiss.

methods.name: _applyEq
methods.description: Applies equalization presets to the audio samples.

methods.name: _OnePoleFilter.lowPass
methods.description: Creates a low-pass filter with specified sample rate and cutoff frequency.

methods.name: _OnePoleFilter.highPass
methods.description: Creates a high-pass filter with specified sample rate and cutoff frequency.

methods.name: _OnePoleFilter.process
methods.description: Processes a single sample through the filter, maintaining filter state.
